ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Staff or Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to build the program foundation for Suno's Security organization. Security is scaling its team, processes, technology, and programs all at once, and today there's no dedicated program function to hold that work together. You'll own the cross-functional structure that turns security priorities into programs that run and get finished. You'll start with Vulnerability Management and Security by Design, and you'll also help our IT organization set up operational structures it can own and run on its own. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Research, and Legal, and as the work grows, you'll have the chance to build a team around it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Drive Suno's Vulnerability Management program end-to-end, covering intake, prioritization, remediation tracking, and verified closure with Engineering.

- Stand up Safety and Security by Design as a repeatable program, with clear processes, checklists, launch gates, and accountability across teams.

- Own Security's roadmap and planning artifacts, turning risk priorities into tracked plans with clear owners and milestones.

- Track incident response follow-ups and post-incident corrective actions until they're verified as resolved.

- Build audit-readiness tracking that maps requirements to owners and evidence across teams.

- Serve as the connective tissue between Security and Engineering, Research, and Legal. You'll surface blockers, sequence dependencies, and drive programs to completion.

- Partner with IT to set up processes, tracking systems, and operating cadences that IT then owns and runs independently.

- Help make security part of how Suno builds every new model and feature, in service of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

MUST-HAVES

- 10+ years of technical program management experience, including significant time running security, infrastructure, or platform programs in a fast-growing engineering organization.

- A track record of building programs from scratch, such as vulnerability management, secure development lifecycle, or launch review, and making them durable and repeatable.

- Enough technical depth to engage credibly with security and software engineers on vulnerabilities, remediation trade-offs, and system dependencies, plus the influence skills to drive outcomes across teams you don't manage.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience supporting security compliance or audit programs (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001) from the program side.

- Experience setting up IT operational processes, tooling, or service management practices.

- Prior experience as the first or founding TPM in a security organization, or interest in growing into a program management leadership role as the team scales.

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We are seeking a highly motivated Thermal Engineer to join our Active Thermal Solutions team. This role is responsible for developing and optimizing active thermal management solutions for high-speed interconnect systems.

Customer Collaboration

Thermal Simulation and Analysis

• Perform sensitivity and optimization studies to ensure thermal performance meets design goals.

Experimental Validation

• Work with lab teams to plan and conduct thermal testing and validation.
• Correlate experimental data with simulation results to refine and validate models.
• Identify and troubleshoot thermal design issues through root-cause analysis and iterative testing.

Optimization and Reporting

• Optimize designs based on simulation and test results to balance performance, cost, and manufacturability.
• Prepare detailed technical reports summarizing analysis, findings, and recommendations.
• Present results and optimized solutions to customers and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of industry experience in thermal design or analysis for cooling electronic systems or interconnect hardware preferred.

**Technical Skills**

• Experience with thermal instrumentation and data acquisition (thermocouples, IR cameras, etc.).
• Familiarity with CAD software (SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar).
• Strong understanding of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and electronic packaging.

**Soft Skills**

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Strong communication and presentation abilities for customer interaction and reporting.
• Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing thermal cooling solutions for electronics packages, such as; ASICs, Front I/O modules, Near package & On-package optics, cold plates, and other electronic liquid cooling solutions.
• Background in active cooling technologies (fans, blowers, heat pipes, vapor chambers, etc.).

• Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE) or statistical optimization methods.

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge interconnect technologies driving next-generation data centers and high-performance computing.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a global engineering environment.

About the Team

The Code Scalability team owns build systems and continuous integration across DoorDash. When a shared dependency changes or more teams contribute to a monorepo, the cost of building software can grow for everyone. We tackle that challenge with Bazel, Buildkite, and infrastructure that keeps everyday development efficient. Our work gives teams a dependable path from a code change to a completed build, with fewer delays and less infrastructure troubleshooting.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on Code Scalability, you will solve the engineering problems behind building software at DoorDash’s scale. A change deep in a monorepo can trigger work across many projects; your job is to make that work efficient, predictable, and easy to investigate when something goes wrong. Projects span Bazel configuration and tooling, Buildkite orchestration, build execution and caching, and the services that support them. You will identify where improvements matter most, make the technical decisions, and work with teams across DoorDash to put those changes into practice. The impact of this role extends to every team that depends on our platform. Shorter queues give engineers more time to iterate, dependable pipelines prevent interruptions, and useful diagnostics help them get back to their work. You will measure progress through those outcomes, alongside the cost and maintainability of the infrastructure you own.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Evolve build and CI workflows for large monorepos, keeping feedback fast and changes manageable as dependencies, code volume, and the number of contributing teams grow.
• Develop Bazel rules, toolchains, and integrations that keep builds reproducible and make shared build infrastructure easier for teams to adopt across large monorepos.
• Improve Buildkite pipeline throughput and reliability by reducing queue times, addressing build bottlenecks, and making better use of CI compute capacity.
• Reduce redundant build work through dependency analysis, incremental builds, caching, and parallel execution, balancing developer feedback speed with infrastructure cost.
• Build developer tools that explain build failures and help engineers reproduce CI behavior locally, making troubleshooting faster and reducing support overhead.
• Rethink what a build and CI platform can do with AI: move beyond reporting failures toward intelligent diagnosis, PR triage, automated recovery, and guidance that helps developers move forward.
• Instrument and operate build and CI infrastructure. Use metrics and developer feedback to track latency, reliability, and resource usage, then address recurring infrastructure problems.
• Lead platform improvements from design through rollout, partner with engineering teams on migrations, and mentor teammates through technical decisions and code reviews.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building developer infrastructure, build systems, or CI platforms.
• You write maintainable production software in a language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, or Python, and bring strong debugging and software design skills.
• You have experience with build or CI systems at scale and can reason about dependencies, incremental builds, caching, and distributed execution. Experience with Bazel, Buildkite, or large monorepos is especially relevant; comparable tools and environments count too.
• You have led technical projects across teams, made practical design tradeoffs, and carried changes through rollout and operational ownership.
• You approach internal platforms as products: you listen to developers, make workflows easier to adopt, and judge success by the problems you solve for them.
• You can investigate performance and reliability problems across multiple components, use evidence to find the cause, and choose solutions that stay understandable as the system grows.
• You improve how a team works through mentorship, clear communication, and automation that removes repetitive work.

The ideal candidate combines strong DevOps and software engineering skills with a passion for automation, cloud technologies, and security-focused problem solving. You will evaluate telemetry and enrichment sources, design and maintain detection content, build integrations and automation, and contribute to the adoption of engineering best practices that improve the speed, quality, and reliability of security detections across Ubisoft's global environment. Responsibilities Evaluate log sources, telemetry feeds, and enrichment data to determine their quality, structure, coverage, and detection value. Design, develop, test, document, deploy, and maintain detection rules, frameworks, and supporting technologies. Drive the migration of detection content into a Detection-as-Code model using version control and modern software development methodologies. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate validation, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of detection content. Build integrations and workflows leveraging APIs and MCP-based interactions across SIEM platforms, EDR solutions, ticketing systems, cloud services, and data repositories. Develop automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort. Collaborate with Security Operations and Incident Response teams to improve detection coverage, fidelity, and investigative capabilities. Create reusable tooling, libraries, and frameworks that support detection engineering initiatives. Implement secure coding practices, code reviews, testing strategies, and quality controls throughout the engineering lifecycle. Support technologies such as Sigma, Sysmon, Falco, and cloud-native security telemetry platforms. Contribute to infrastructure automation and platform engineering initiatives involving public cloud and containerized environments. Research emerging technologies and innovative approaches that improve detection engineering outcomes. Translate business and project requirements into clear technical specifications and implementation plans. Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise. Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational procedures. Required Experience in software engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or automation-focused roles. Strong experience with Git-based development workflows and source control management. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Go, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar. Experience integrating platforms and services through APIs. Strong understanding of software development best practices, testing methodologies, and secure coding principles. Experience working with modern cloud platforms and infrastructure technologies. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to translate business requirements into technical requirements and effectively communicate those requirements to development teams. Preferred Experience in Detection Engineering, Security Operations, Threat Detection, Incident Response, or Security Engineering. Familiarity with SIEM, EDR, and enterprise logging platforms. Experience with Sigma rules, Sysmon, Falco, or related detection technologies. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized environments. Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or multi-cloud environments. Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, and modern detection methodologies. Experience leveraging AI-powered development workflows, including agentic coding, automated code review, unit testing, linting, context management, and iterative improvement processes. Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI skills development, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Key Attributes The ideal candidate is a builder, problem solver, and collaborator who enjoys combining software engineering, automation, cloud technologies, and security challenges. You thrive in dynamic environments, are comfortable learning new technologies, and continuously seek opportunities to improve processes and systems. Your ability to combine technical depth with clear communication and practical execution will be instrumental in the evolution of Ubisoft’s detection engineering capabilities. COMPANY OVERVIEW

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.​

Overview

As the Senior Engineer – Maintenance Planning & Scheduling, you will improve maintenance effectiveness by ensuring work is planned, scheduled and executed efficiently. You will coordinate labor, parts, tools and timelines for safety, food safety, corrective and preventive maintenance activities. Working with Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, Purchasing and Storeroom teams, you will use Maximo, maintenance data and reliability principles to improve equipment availability and maintenance productivity. The shit timing for the role is 3:30 pm to 12:30 am.

Key Accountabilities

• Review work requests to ensure all required information is complete and accurate before planning.
• Plan labor, parts, tools and timelines for safety, food safety, corrective and preventive maintenance work orders.
• Coordinate with Line Teams, Maintenance and Engineering to prioritize and schedule work using Maximo and other planning tools.
• Maintain asset hierarchies, job plans and preventive maintenance routines in the system.
• Support job plan standardization and provide basic guidance and training on Maximo usage.
• Initiate the Item Request Management process and partner with Purchasing and the Storeroom to maintain accurate spare-part information.
• Review completed work orders and compare planned versus actual labor and material usage to improve future planning accuracy.
• Analyze maintenance and reliability data to identify gaps in preventive maintenance strategies and recommend improvements.
• Support the site Maintenance Planning and Scheduling tool by providing guidance and training.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

• Full-time Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited university.
• Preferred disciplines include Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Production, Electronics, Instrumentation or Telecommunications Engineering.

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in plant operations, maintenance or a related engineering field.
• Experience in maintenance planning and scheduling.
• Experience working with maintenance work orders, preventive maintenance and equipment reliability.

Technical Skills

• Working knowledge of maintenance planning concepts and computerized maintenance management systems, preferably Maximo.
• Understanding of preventive maintenance and equipment reliability principles.
• Ability to analyze maintenance data and identify opportunities to improve planning and maintenance strategies.
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Soft Skills

• Strong verbal, written and electronic communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively with Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, Purchasing and Storeroom teams.
• Strong prioritization, coordination and problem-solving skills.
• Personal accountability, adaptability and willingness to grow into broader planning or reliability-focused roles.

Preferred Qualifications

• Relevant certification in Reliability or Maintenance.
• Experience supporting maintenance planning and scheduling tools.
• Experience in a manufacturing plant or maintenance environment.
• Interest in developing a career in maintenance planning, reliability or engineering solutions.

ELIGIBILITY

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.
